arStrings.szText:
Your Minions gain {c_number}[{SF_1} * 100|%+|]{/c} Attack Speed and deal {c_number}[{SF_2} * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage. 

When one of your Minions die, your other Minions enrage, dealing {c_number}[{SF_3} * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage for {c_number}{buffduration:ENRAGE}{/c} seconds.
